page.overview:
Who is Fang Daimyō?

The unnamed daimyō of the Land of Fangs was sent a peace message by the Claw Daimyō when their two countries were close to a war.

Although the post-officer accidentally delivered a manuscript for the newest Icha Icha novel ghostwritten by Naruto instead, the Fang Daimyō loved it and accepted it as a gift to call off the war.
